lines: In a group class, a live board now ranks every rider by output, sent by the service once a second.
It reads Output with your place, lists every rider by kilojoules, highest first, and marks your own row.
Each second the ride sends your output and power to the hub, and never more than twice a second.
At the start, bots fill the empty seats to ten, each riding a steady pace with a swing of its own.
Pull ahead, and the next standings slide you up the board.
On a laptop the board is a column beside the video; on a phone it sits underneath.
What the tests prove: ranked by output, bots up to ten, reports at most twice a second, and your row marked.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
